jobs.instructions: Speak in clear Modern Standard Arabic as a warm, composed preschool teacher. Use the same natural feminine middle-register voice, steady and gently encouraging. Read the complete supplied phrase once, in ordinary smooth classroom speech. Make a small natural pause around the middle teaching example. The middle example is adh-dhi: short a, doubled voiced dental dh, short i. Preserve the short final i before moving to the next words. Do not elongate the vowel or repeat the example. Speak only the supplied Arabic phrase, without commentary, music or sound effects.
jobs.pronunciationGuide: Full phrase: “We say: adh-dhi, then we listen.” The middle example is adh-dhi: short a, doubled voiced dental dh, short i. Review the whole phrase; any later cut needs separate approval.
